name: 20748 · Temple Hills, MD
findings: ZIP 20748 (Temple Hills) has 186 nonprofit organizations. 59 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (48% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20748 (Temple Hills) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 20748 (Temple Hills) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).
